correctness.rationale: Checked complete occupancy classification: permissible faces occupy one part, two parts with at least one singleton, or precisely three singleton parts. Any other pattern contains an explicit four-vertex simple path. X contains full 2-skeleton and is simply connected. The contractible star cover U_i has pairwise one-dimensional intersections; Mayer–Vietoris induction yields H_j(Z)=0 above degree2 and torsionfree H2, and attaching only rainbow triangles to form X preserves these properties. Integral Euler characteristic from exhaustive face enumerator yields β, and Hurewicz+Whitehead gives ∨βS², including degenerate singleton cases. Signed fixed-simplex Lefschetz traces depend only on per-part fixed points f_i, yielding the proposed polynomial and semisimple rational representation with multiplicities choose(m−1,3), choose(m−1,2), m−1,1. Independently enumerated all actual length-3 simple paths and checked classification/Euler counts for nine size tuples including (3,3,3) β38, (2,2,2,2) β35; package contains broader 64 tuple mod2 and 123 class-character checks. Finite samples are corroboration, not the all-parameter proof.
